import networkx as nx

edges = [(0, 7), (0, 9), (0, 10), (0, 18), (1, 6), (1, 12), (1, 18), (2, 4), (2, 11), (2, 13), (2, 19), (3, 5), (3, 7), (3, 8), (4, 10), (4, 16), (5, 12), (5, 16), (6, 13), (6, 14), (6, 15), (7, 13), (8, 14), (8, 17), (9, 11), (9, 15), (10, 14), (11, 12), (15, 20), (16, 20), (17, 19), (17, 20), (18, 19)]

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_edges_from(edges)

def girth(G):
    min_cycle = float('inf')
    for n in G.nodes():
        for target in G.neighbors(n):
            G.remove_edge(n, target)
            try:
                path_length = nx.shortest_path_length(G, n, target)
                min_cycle = min(min_cycle, path_length + 1)
            except nx.NetworkXNoPath:
                pass
            G.add_edge(n, target)
    return min_cycle

print("Girth:", girth(G))
print("Degrees:", [d for n, d in G.degree()])
